initial_256_only_candidate_stress_compar.interpretation: Retained initial result. c1 regressed14.2%; both complete versions later reproduced post-EOS continuation drift. The natural coding comparison is separate and honors EOS.

limitations: Whole-version comparison. No per-feature ablation or attribution.
Natural coding repeats one weighted-interval task with a shared 33005-token reference, not a diverse multi-task benchmark.
Code implementations vary; semantic checks are independent, tokens are actual reported completion counts, EOS is honored.
Legacy ignore_eos fixed512 includes output after natural EOS and has continuation/acceptance instability in both versions.
Two warmup rounds excluded for natural coding; one warmup excluded for legacy.
Streaming first chunk is a TTFT proxy; estimated decode rate is not a per-token trace.
Round resampling does not remove run-order or system-state confounders; one full run per arm.
Burst concurrency does not establish steady-arrival SLA capacity or simultaneous 600k capacity.
Cold baseline is the initial fresh v10 run; natural coding baseline is a second complete v10 restart. Cold latency is single-sample and not a distribution.
First candidate cold600k measured73.398s; final four-bucket configuration measured78.295s. The final result is reported, not the best trial.
Warm600k throughput remains a forced-length stress metric; its TTFT occurs before natural EOS.
Health service checks remain part of the deployment; no profiler or GPU component workload overlaps endpoint timing.
